title: Replace getByTestId with Accessible Queries
prompt:
Tests that hunt by `data-testid` brittle and disconnect from how users interact with the page. Rewrite a test using `getByRole`, `getByLabelText`, and `getByText`.

**Requirements:**
1. In `Card.test.tsx`, import `render`, `screen` from `@testing-library/react`, `userEvent` (default), and `Card` from `./Card`.
2. Inside `it('uses accessible queries', async () => { ... })`:
   - `const user = userEvent.setup();`
   - `render(<Card />);`
   - Assert the heading: `expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Profile' })).toBeDefined();`.
   - Type into the bio: `await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('bio'), 'hi');`.
   - Submit via accessible button: `await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'save' }));`.
   - Assert toast: `expect(screen.getByText('saved')).toBeDefined();`.
hints: `getByRole('heading', { name })` lets you target an `<h2>` by its visible text without coupling to the tag.
Inputs with `<label htmlFor>` show up via `getByLabelText` -- this also exercises the same a11y wiring real users rely on.
